thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool 'elmbridge-prod' GPU pressure > 95% — queue=42, avg_latency=3.2s. paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:
sam_sre: on it, joining the thread
maya_oncall: joining — which region/pool?
sam_sre: us-west-2, pool=elmbridge-prod-dedicated, tenant=Elmbridge Inc. seeing sustained GPU util, backlog on inference small requests + one large batch job
leo_prodeng: I can see 4/8 GPUs fully saturated and queue growing. Batch job looks like nightly retrain kicked off early for tenant.
nines_support: Elmbridge support reported customer-facing latency spikes at 15:02. They've been paged and want updates. Contact: Paul S.
grant_tse: checking tenant config — autoscale policy max_replicas=8, burst: false, quota_consumed=100% (account limit hit)
sam_sre: autoscaler didn't add replicas because org quota is at limit. burst disabled by default for this customer.
maya_oncall: can we enable burst manually? contractually allowed? @carmen_am
carmen_am: Elmbridge has an emergency-burst clause (sev1) up to 2x capacity for 2 hours with cost recovery + postmortem. I approve emergency burst now.
sam_sre: ok applying temporary burst. running command:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated burst enable --pool elmbridge-prod --tenant elmbridge --duration 60m --allow-spot-fallback
```
sam_sre: command submitted, provisioning request id=pr-8932
incident-bot: provision request accepted id=pr-8932 status=queued
leo_prodeng: while nodes come up, recommend pausing non-essential batch jobs for this tenant to reduce pressure. grant_tse can we evict or pause?
grant_tse: yes — pausing batch retrain job now. running evacuation:
```bash
redwoodctl tenant evict-jobs --tenant elmbridge --filter 'job_type:batch' --dry-run=false
```
grant_tse: batch job paused, artifacts saved, resumed to be scheduled after incident window
ines_support: notifying Elmbridge: "We are enabling emergency capacity and pausing background batch jobs to restore latency. ETA ~6-8 minutes." (message sent)
Paul S.: (from customer) Thank you — please keep us posted. This is impacting ingested chat latency.
maya_oncall: nodes provisioning: 4/4 additional GPU nodes allocated, starting to join cluster (approx 4m ETA)
sam_sre: small note — one service within their tenant is holding very large KV caches and long sequences, causing memory pressure. I'm applying a temporary max_seq_len limit for tenant to relieve KV churn for 30m:
```yaml
policies:
  - tenant: elmbridge
    max_seq_len: 1024
    enforced_until: 2026-03-17T16:40:00Z
```
sam_sre: policy applied
leo_prodeng: also enabling fallback routing for very long requests to use smaller model to reduce per-token load
sam_sre: enabling fallback rule:
```bash
redwoodctl routes update --tenant elmbridge --fallback-model redwood-medium --threshold 500
```
incident-bot: metrics update: queue length dropping from 42 -> 12 over 3 minutes, avg latency -> 1.1s
ines_support: customer confirmed latency improving, still seeing intermittent 5s spikes on complex prompts
leo_prodeng: those spikes likely from requests that bypassed fallback — adding quick rule to throttle single-request token limit to 2k for 30m
sam_sre: throttle rule in place. monitoring.
incident-bot: severity downgraded to P2 — customer impact reduced :white_check_mark:
nines_support: Elmbridge asked for timeline and billing implications — @carmen_am please follow up
carmen_am: will handle billing, will request usage window + costs. prepping to send notice.
maya_oncall: planning handoff in 45m. @sam_sre please create incident ticket and assign postmortem owners
sam_sre: created INC-20260317-821, assigned to eng-runtime + prodeng + support. brief summary: emergency burst enabled 60m, paused batch jobs, limited seq_len, fallback model enabled, throttle added. monitoring for 2h.
leo_prodeng: recommended action items for postmortem: 1) consider enabling auto-burst for Elmbridge in contract, 2) increase autoscale quota or implement failover checks for quota exhaustion, 3) detect tenant batch jobs scheduled during peak hours and warn.
nines_support: customer is satisfied with current performance. They requested RCA and confirmation their jobs will not be auto-evicted without notice. noted.
maya_oncall: handing off to next on-call in 45m. Sam will be point for follow-ups.
sam_sre: will remain watch for 2h and update ticket with logs + metrics.
incident-bot: incident thread will be archived after handoff. Next status update in 30m.
